propositions: The --reason flag is advertised on all transition subcommands but is parsed and then silently discarded on plain (non-force) closes
close_reason parameter exists in transition_core signature but is never read or used in the function body
--reason is only meaningfully applied when --force is used, creating false user expectation that rationale is recorded
The ticket scope explicitly rejects adding persistence for free-text close reasons; machine-readable CLOSE_CLASSES vocabulary is the intentional replacement
--reason must either document its applicability to force paths only or be refused on plain closes to prevent silent data loss
